title: 7.18.1 Reading: Three actions, a flag and a count
description: A guarding flag halves the next hit with floor(n / 2) and is cleared by it; a potions count heals with min(hp + 12, maxHp) and runs out; one act(t, a, roll) does all three actions, picked with 1, 2 and 3, and the enemy chooses with a simple rule.
